methodology.builds: Cargo release profile, locked dependencies, default LLVM feature; Rust 1.99.0 and LLVM 23.1.2.
methodology.baseline: 326003d545364e209faf2515702f2ef2682e9bb4 (0.1.4, before the latest flow-analysis refinements; already includes the earlier flow checker).
methodology.ordering: Each compiler built before measurement; cases run sequentially. Main current series precedes the baseline series. Repeats follow both series.
methodology.sampling: Five warmup changes per fixture. 100 timed changes except 5,000-local stress and 2,000-local comment controls (30 each). No inter-sample delay.
methodology.paths: Absolute repository paths in compiler and command fields normalized to repository-relative paths for publication.
methodology.host_observation: 4,362.56 MiB swap allocated during the series; a later memory_pressure query reported 44% memory free. These observations do not identify the cause of long tails.
methodology.limits: Single host, one server process per fixture. Percentiles describe these runs, not CI thresholds or a measured cache speedup.
